title: Count Integers Appearing in a Single Block
summary: Given an integer array, count the number of unique integers that appear consecutively without interruption.
statement: Given an integer array, count the number of unique integers that appear consecutively without interruption.
constraints: A value is special when all its occurrences form one uninterrupted contiguous block.
Return the number of distinct special values.
hints: Compress the array conceptually into maximal runs.
Count how many runs belong to each value.
Increment a value only at index zero or when it differs from the previous value; count frequencies equal to one.
A value’s occurrences are contiguous exactly when it creates one maximal run.
editorial: A value’s occurrences are contiguous exactly when it creates one maximal run.

tests.explanation: One occurs in two separated blocks, while two occurs in one block, so return one.
Three and two each form one block; one forms two blocks, so return two.
